RoomType.rationale: AeonglassBoss.cs:11 `RoomType => RoomType.Boss`. The sim's `Encounter` dataclass carries no `RoomType` field; the type is modeled structurally by pool membership (`ActRooms.boss_keys`, rooms.py:43-64) -- `aeonglass` is listed there, matching `RoomType.Boss`, and it also feeds `RoomSet.next_boss_encounter` (rooms.py:554-559) and the gold ladder (see the guard below). One shared mechanism across this batch; see `encounter/_room_type_and_weak` in the report.

BossNodeSpineResource.rationale: Presentation only -- the map-node spine animation asset for the boss icon. AeonglassBoss.cs:13 overrides the base's `ResourceLoader.Exists`-gated lookup (EncounterModel.cs:200-210) with an unconditional `null`, i.e. Aeonglass has no bespoke spine node and falls back to the static PNG path (`MapNodeAssetPaths`, EncounterModel.cs:217-231). The headless sim has no map-node rendering at all.

BossNodePath.rationale: Presentation only -- asset path string for the boss map icon (AeonglassBoss.cs:15, overriding the base's default templated path at EncounterModel.cs:198). No sim analogue; no asset loading in the headless sim.

CustomBgm.rationale: Presentation only -- AeonglassBoss.cs:17 names `event:/music/act3_boss_queen` (Aeonglass's boss fight deliberately reuses the Queen's boss theme on the GAME side; noted only because it looks like a copy-paste error and is not one). No audio in the headless sim.

HasCustomBackground.rationale: Presentation only. AeonglassBoss.cs:19 `protected override bool HasCustomBackground => false` -- a no-op override of the base's own default (EncounterModel.cs:188, also `false`); Aeonglass uses the act's generated background like any other Glory encounter. No background rendering in the headless sim.

AllPossibleMonsters.issue: AeonglassBoss.cs:21 returns a single-element list with `Aeonglass`. Shared finding across all nine units in this batch, filed once under `encounter/_all_possible_monsters`: the sim has no `AllPossibleMonsters` analogue at all (`grep -rn AllPossibleMonsters sts2_rl/` returns nothing). Enumerated cost from the game side: exactly three consumers game-wide (`UnlockConsoleCmd.cs:68`, `:147`; `NGeneralStatsGrid.cs:164`), all dev-console/stats-screen UI, none RNG- or combat-affecting. Dormant: the headless sim has neither feature.

GetCameraScaling.rationale: Presentation only. AeonglassBoss.cs:23-26 returns 0.9f. No camera in the headless sim.

GetCameraOffset.rationale: Presentation only. AeonglassBoss.cs:28-31 returns Vector2.Down*60f. No camera in the headless sim.

GenerateMonsters.rationale: ROSTER: AeonglassBoss.cs:33-36 returns exactly one `(Aeonglass, null)` pair; `AEONGLASS_BOSS = Encounter(id="aeonglass_boss", monster_classes=[Aeonglass])` (aeonglass.py:119-122) -- one monster, same class. ORDER: trivially matches (single element). SLOT: C# passes `null`; the sim's `monster_slots` defaults to `()`, leaving `slot_name` at its default `None` on the sim side too -- both null. DRAW COUNT: zero on both sides -- `AeonglassBoss.GenerateMonsters` (AeonglassBoss.cs:33-36) never touches `base.Rng`, and `Encounter.create_monsters`'s fixed-composition path draws nothing (monsters/base.py:408-411).

ShouldReceiveCombatHooks.rationale: `EncounterModel.ShouldReceiveCombatHooks => false` (EncounterModel.cs:39), not overridden by AeonglassBoss. The sim's `Encounter` dataclass is never registered with `HookSystem` anywhere in the codebase -- it is never a hook listener on either side.

guards.what: Draw count / stream independence of the per-encounter Rng
guards.rationale: Zero draws (see GenerateMonsters above), so the per-encounter Rng's independence guarantee is never exercised by this unit -- nothing to desynchronise. `sts2_rl/rng.py:52-67`'s `make_encounter_rng` reproduces the seed formula for encounters that do draw; this is not one of them.

guards.what: The Niche HP-roll (Aeonglass has min_hp==max_hp==512, a degenerate range like Mecha Knight)
guards.rationale: Same shape as `encounter/mecha_knight`'s Niche check, run again here rather than assumed: `Creature.SetUniqueMonsterHpValue` (Creature.cs:371-383) draws once off `RunState.Rng.Niche` even for a degenerate one-value range (`hashSet={512}`, `Count<=0` is false so `NextItem` fires). The sim's `CombatState._roll_parity_hp` (combat.py:402-422) does the same: `candidates=[512]`, `niche.next_int_range(0,1)` -- one draw, matching.

rooms.py:270 lists `aeonglass` in Glory's `boss_keys`, and `AEONGLASS_BOSS` is registered in `sts2_rl/monsters/glory/__init__.py`'s `ENCOUNTERS` dict (line 76). Reachable with fully ported content on both sides.
